summary: Inject control-flow hint on tool failure to prevent uncritical acceptance of negative VQA consensus.

edits.hypothesis: Injecting a direct user-message instruction into the conversation history immediately after a tool failure forces the agent to re-evaluate negative findings against original pixels, addressing the 'uncritical_acceptance_of_contradictory_vqa_output' mode observed in q000001, q000004, q000005, and q000008.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prompt edits in AGENT_SYSTEM are static and may be diluted by subsequent tool observations; a dynamic injection at the point of failure ensures the heuristic is active exactly when the agent is most vulnerable to accepting false negatives from fallback tools.
edits.trigger_condition: When tool_failure_reason(obs) returns a non-None value in the executor loop.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001, after roi_crop failed, the injected message would have warned against accepting llava_med_qa's negative output as definitive, prompting a re-examination of the original image which likely contains the pathology. (preservative) Success habits like direct visual reasoning (q000003) are unaffected as no tool failure occurs. (transfer) Generalizes to any task where a high-resolution inspection tool fails and the agent falls back to a less sensitive VQA model.
edits.regression_risk: Minimal; the message is only injected on failure and reinforces existing system prompt instructions without contradicting them.
edits.mechanism: Injecting a direct user-message instruction into the conversation history immediately after a tool failure forces the agent to re-evaluate negative findings against original pixels, addressing the 'uncritical_acceptance_of_contradictory_vqa_output' mode observed in q000001, q000004, q000005, and q000008.
